Entry = geometric mean over benchmarks of `ratio_uniform_mean`, one run per cell, so **no intervals** (say so in the caption note).
  > 
  > Block 1, columns: stage A extrapolation, stage A interpolation (7 benchmarks, interpolation over 5 folds); stage B extrapolation, stage B interpolation (6 benchmarks without MMLU-Pro, interpolation fold 0). Rows, with the stage each row exists in (blank elsewhere):

  >  - ours, same cells: anchor x mean, anchor x IRT plug-in, anchor x difference IRT (anchor|mean, anchor|irt-plugin, anchor|diff-irt; each in A and B, values differ by the benchmark set), stratified x mean (strat|mean).
  >  Values I read (please recompute, do not copy): A extrap/interp: tb-correct 2.49/1.14, AP 1.51/1.38, anchor|mean 1.91/1.07, strat 0.84/0.79(0.80?); B: tb-anchor-irt 0.94/0.82, p-IRT correctness 1.05/0.69, p-IRT IRT 0.88/0.69, anchor|mean 1.99/1.09, anchor|irt-plugin 2.10/0.79, anchor|diff-irt 1.76/0.62, strat 0.85/0.79.
  > Block 2, "our IRT estimators, extrapolation fold, six benchmarks (stage B cells)": rows = our IRT plug-in on the anchor design and on the uniform design; columns = 2 dimensions with the default prior (config d2), 10 dimensions (d10), 2 dimensions with the wide ability prior (d2w, irtw-plugin), 10 dimensions with it (d10, irtw-plugin). I read 2.10, 1.94, 1.99, 2.01 (anchor) and 1.60, 2.00, 1.47, 2.04 (uniform). If you think the IRT model row (irt-model) belongs there too, add it.
